capsule.desc_1: A scoop neckline, small buttons and cream lace. A fitted silhouette in chocolate.
capsule.desc_2: A chocolate tie bolero over a sky-blue camisole with a small floral detail.
capsule.desc_3: Fine chocolate and cream stripes, an open neckline and long sleeves.
capsule.desc_4: A fluid burgundy silhouette with lace edges. Wear it alone or under knitwear.
capsule.desc_5: Ribbed lines, a buttoned neckline and a cream underlayer. A fitted masculine silhouette.
capsule.desc_6: Chocolate knitwear over a sky-blue tank. Two shades and a play on layers.
capsule.desc_7: Chocolate and cream stripes, a button placket and long sleeves.
capsule.desc_8: A short-sleeve burgundy henley over grey long sleeves. Two lengths and two shades.
